captions.instagram:
Concept. Not a client project. Wrenfield is a fictional café.

Open on Boxing Day? On this homepage you swipe through photos, read “Open 7 days” (true, except when it isn’t), and the Christmas hours are in an Instagram post that never finishes loading.

So we put today’s hours under the name and the holiday hours on the homepage as plain text, every changed day from 24 December to 1 January. Then one button to call.

Are your holiday hours somewhere people will find them? Free review at prycedigital.com/book

captions.linkedin:
Concept. Not a client project. A fictional café’s homepage, redesigned for the holidays.

Every December the same question comes in: are you open on the 26th? This homepage answers with a photo slider, an “Open 7 days” line that stops being true on Christmas Day, and an Instagram feed that is meant to hold the holiday hours but is still loading.

The new version shows today’s hours under the name and lists every changed day from 24 December to 1 January as plain text, with a button to call.

It’s a small change that saves a lot of phone calls, and a few wasted trips. If your holiday hours only live on social media, I’m happy to take a look: prycedigital.com/book
